Devon (CS Ops): FYI — ZenHealth hit us with a SOC2 + DPA + 25-page vendor questionnaire. Onboarding is waiting on these. Can we triage? @Elaine (CS) @Sara (Security)
Elaine (CS): Got it. I have the SOC2 Type II PDF and our DPA template. Will upload and share links in this thread by EOD. :white_check_mark:
Sara (Security): Quick ask: does ZenHealth require data residency (EU-only) or KMS/HSM proof? Need to know scoping before I answer the questionnaire. Also I prefer to answer the technical matrix directly (encryption, RBAC, logging, incident response).
Devon (CS Ops): They indicated EU data residency in their RFP, and they want KMS key separation on paper. POC is in US, but final will be EU. Flagging possible transfer controls.
security-bot: Automated check — our DPA template includes standard SCCs. Missing explicit HSM integration statement. Flag: "HSM_STATEMENT_MISSING".
Elaine (CS): Copy. I'll redact internal contact emails and add security@redwood.com. Uploading now: https://storage.redwood.internal/zenhealth/soc2-typeii.pdf and https://storage.redwood.internal/zenhealth/dpa-template.docx
Mike (Sales AE): Heads-up — ZenHealth timeline is tight. If we stall on the questionnaire they'll likely push to another vendor. Can CS/security prioritize? :pray:
Sara (Security): On it. I'll start filling the questionnaire. For the repeated matrix items, here's my suggested shorthand to paste where allowed:

```
Encryption at rest: AES-256 (customer data partitioned per tenant)
Key management: KMS with customer-managed keys (where enabled); HSM-backed KMS available for Private deployments
Access control: RBAC + short-lived MFA sessions + SCIM for SSO
Logging & retention: Audit logs retained 365 days (longer by enterprise add-on)
Incident response: IR playbook + SLA for notification within 72 hours
```

Sara (Security): Devon — can you confirm whether ZenHealth requested customer-managed KMS for POC or only for production? That changes how we phrase the POC answers.
Devon (CS Ops): They asked for "KMS separation options" on the form and said "prefer HSM" in the legal email. For POC they said it's negotiable but want it documented.
Elaine (CS): Quick note: the SOC2 PDF contains an older control testbed name. I will attach a short attestation file that maps the cert to our current infra.
Elaine (CS): Attestation: https://storage.redwood.internal/zenhealth/soc2-attestation.txt
security-bot: Policy reminder: when sending SOC2 artifacts externally, use pre-signed link with expiry <= 7 days. Detected links above have 30d default. Suggest regenerating with 7d expiry.
Elaine (CS): Good catch — regenerating now with 7d expiry. New links in 2m.
Mike (Sales AE): Also: ZenHealth legal asked if we will sign their vendor questionnaire or if CS can return answers on our behalf. They prefer us to fill directly. That might speed things up.
Sara (Security): I can complete the technical sections if CS populates product-specific bits (regions used, PII categories). Devon/ELAINE please paste the following small table answers inline and I’ll cut/paste:
- Regions in-scope for POC: 
- Final deployment region preference:
- Types of PII collected (high level):

Devon (CS Ops): Regions in-scope for POC: us-west-2. Final deployment preference: eu-west-1. PII types: names, email, hashed identifiers, limited health meta (non-clinical) — no PHI expected for this integration.
Elaine (CS): Added product bits to the questionnaire draft in the shared doc and pinged legal for DPA deviation notes.
Sara (Security): I'll run through and finish the vendor questionnaire draft within one business day and then send to legal for sign-off.
Devon (CS Ops): Great — action items: Elaine upload final artifacts (SOC2 + attestation + 7d links) by EOD; Sara complete questionnaire draft in 1 business day; Devon will update onboarding tracker and notify ZenHealth that docs are incoming.
Elaine (CS): Done — regenerated links: https://storage.redwood.internal/zenhealth/soc2-typeii-7d.pdf ; https://storage.redwood.internal/zenhealth/dpa-template-7d.docx
Mike (Sales AE): Thanks team — I'll tell ZenHealth we can turn around the questionnaire quickly. This should reduce churn risk on the deal.
Devon (CS Ops): Noted. I'll also flag renewal risk low if we close POC this month. Will update account health: "onboarding — awaiting security questionnaire (in progress)".
Sara (Security): Final note: I'll add an explicit HSM statement for Private deployments and indicate KMS options for Hosted. Will call out residual risk and propose mitigation language for the DPA.
Elaine (CS): Thanks all. If anyone has edits to the questionnaire, drop them in the shared doc or ping me directly. :slightly_smiling_face:
Devon (CS Ops): Thanks — closing loop here after Sara signs off and legal approves. :handshake:
